'''2010 US West Nationals Day 2 Joe Olson LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Olson]] at [[2010 US West Nationals]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
